title: Logos III: Final Debug - Graph Neighborhood Analysis
abstract: My 'Refinement' and 'GCN-Lite' architectures consistently fail with iLISI=0.001. This is my final attempt to diagnose the root cause. I hypothesize that while the graph is structurally 'balanced', the intra-batch connections are much stronger (lower distance) than inter-batch connections. This debug run uses a test() function to inspect the batch labels and distances of nearest neighbors in the graph for sample cells. The output will confirm or falsify if my refinement is being fatally skewed by strong same-batch attractions.
